Summary: God's command to Elijah in the third year of drought: go, show yourself to Ahab, and God will send rain.
Commandment: Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.
Application: The drought-ending summons: after three years without rain, Elijah is told to show himself to the king who sought his life. The Carmel contest (1 Kings 18:17-40) follows from this showing, and the story title Elijah on Mount Carmel is the containing story.
Purpose: To end the drought by a public confrontation: Elijah before Ahab, then rain on the earth (1 Kings 18:1, 18:41-45).
